title: Three Pieces of Ramp
hook: The ramp is three jobs. Not one lane.
scene: Overcast afternoon on the I-5 south on-ramp. From above you can see the whole thing: a short entrance where you search the highway, a longer acceleration stretch, then merge paint where the ramp joins the right travel lane. The Menace is still in the entrance. A sedan is already at speed in the right lane of the highway. Tower 4 wants you in that lane. The ramp is not a single shove.
decision: You are in the entrance stretch. What is this piece of ramp for?

options.text: Search the highway here: find a gap and decide the speed you will need
options.result: You look, you pick a gap in the right lane, and you know the speed before you run at it. The next stretch is for matching. The last stretch is for the paint. Each piece did one job.

options.text: Floor it from the first foot so you hit the highway already faster than they are
options.result: You light the entrance. The sedan has to lift. You arrive hot with no gap and a stack of brake lamps. The first stretch was for looking, not for a launch.

options.text: Stop at the bottom and wait until the right lane is empty as far as you can see
options.result: You plant the Beetle at the entrance. Nobody empties a highway for you. The acceleration stretch is now a standing start. You made the merge from zero.

options.text: Treat the whole ramp as the merge and slide over as soon as you see skip-dash
options.result: You take their paint in the middle of the run-up. You are still slow. The sedan stands on it. Merge paint is at the end, not wherever you got impatient.

debrief: Entrance to search, acceleration to match, merge to take the gap. Look through the first stretch before you run it.
